Allowed origins: `http://localhost:4200` (exact), plus any subdomain of `.pages.dev` or `.workers.dev` — in `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` function (lines ~20-29).

To add a new custom domain, edit that `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts`: add either an exact string match (e.g. `origin === 'https://mydomain.com'`) or an `.endsWith('.mydomain.com')` check, following the same pattern as the existing checks. Since Hono's array-form CORS only matches exact strings (no wildcards), you must edit this function, not pass an array.
